notes.title: Traditional and Simplified Chinese Now Available!
notes.content: [h3]Au Revoir is now accessible to even more players around the world![/h3][p][/p][p]Our latest update adds full support for both [b]Simplified[/b] and [b]Traditional Chinese[/b] — a key step in bringing the game's immersive experience to a broader audience.[/p][p]Step into the year 2071 as a Sentinel working for Au Revoir Ltd. Uncover hidden truths, make impactful decisions that shape the fate of each character, and explore neon-noir environments filled with mystery, tension, and retro-futuristic vibes — now fully localized for Chinese-speaking players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090100/0d5afc8b29a43ccf3523a1f3c605d732a7f75177.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Get ready to revisit Au Revoir with a whole new perspective.[/p]

notes.title: French available!!
notes.content:
🌆 Au Revoir - Now Available in French! 🇫🇷
Dive even deeper into the cyberpunk world of Au Revoir! The game is now available in French, bringing a new level of immersion to players around the globe.

Experience the classic 90s-style point-and-click noir, set in 2071, where Au Revoir Ltd. has revolutionized the world with synthetic brains that store human consciousness, allowing the wealthy to transcend death by transferring their minds into new bodies.

You play as Tristan, a Sentinel for the corporation, tasked with retrieving these consciousnesses. But during a routine mission, a terrifying doubt arises: what if there are flaws in his own synthetic brain?

Your choices will shape the fate of everyone, leading to multiple endings and intense moral dilemmas.

Now, with French language support, even more players can uncover the mysteries of Neon Noir.
